specification.objective: Add a sidebar panel for reviewing every Prisma-tagged session across registered profiles, with focused discovery and navigation.

requirements.statement: A Tagged sessions page is reachable from the Hermes Desktop sidebar and lists only sessions assigned a configured Prisma tag across every registered profile route, including assignments whose session details are not returned by the profile session listing.
The page supports filtering by profile and tag, searching session title/preview/ID, and opening a resolved session through its owning profile route.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The sidebar entry opens the Tagged sessions route; the page queries every profile route rather than only the active profile, shows each assigned tagged session, and retains unmatched assignments in an explicit unavailable-details group.
Profile, tag, and text filters narrow the displayed rows; opening a resolved row passes its session ID and exact owning route to the SDK, while unavailable rows cannot be opened.
The page provides clear loading, error, empty, result-count, and partial-list feedback using accessible controls and existing Hermes Desktop UI components.

invariants.statement: Existing tag definitions, session assignments, color overrides, profile accent behavior, and session-row decorations remain unchanged.
Reading the page does not mutate sessions, tags, profile settings, or active-profile scope.

forbidden_states.statement: The panel silently limits its results to the active profile or hides a persisted tagged-session assignment that lacks matching session details.
Opening a listed session drops its owning profile route or the page displays untagged sessions as tagged.

inputs.statement: Prisma tag definitions and session-ID-to-tag-ID assignments from plugin-scoped storage.
Registered profile routes and persisted session-list pages provided by the Hermes Desktop SDK.
User profile, tag, and text filter selections.

outputs.statement: A sidebar-accessible, grouped and filterable list of tagged sessions, with explicit fallback entries for unavailable session details.

failure_semantics.statement: A profile-listing failure is surfaced without discarding successful profile results; affected stored assignments remain visible by ID, and a profile inventory failure provides a retryable error state.

baseline_output_contains: sidebar panel lists tagged sessions across profiles
tagged sessions can be filtered by profile and tag, searched, and opened
